criterion: which semantic relation holds between the two entities stated at the end of the text ("The relation between X and Y")

categories.name: Location
categories.definition: Entity Y is a geographical location, facility, or region associated with entity X, such as a place of birth, residence, venue, or administrative area.

categories.name: Employer-Organization
categories.definition: Entity X is a person who holds a position, office, or role within entity Y, which is an organization, government, or group.

categories.name: Creator-Creative Work
categories.definition: Entity X is the author, artist, developer, director, or composer of entity Y, which is a creative work such as a book, film, game, or song.

categories.name: Parent-Subsidiary
categories.definition: Entity X is the parent company, owner, or acquiring entity of entity Y, or Y is a subsidiary, division, or brand of X.

categories.name: Event-Participant
categories.definition: Entity X is a participant, competitor, or team involved in entity Y, which is a specific event, competition, or tournament.

categories.name: Family
categories.definition: Entity X and entity Y are related by blood, marriage, or lineage, such as parent-child, sibling, or spousal relationships.

categories.name: Part-Whole
categories.definition: Entity X is a component, part, or subset of entity Y, or Y is a larger entity containing X, including geographical or organizational hierarchies.

categories.name: Origin-Nationality
categories.definition: Entity X is a person, group, or product originating from or associated with entity Y, which is a country, nationality, or ethnic group.

categories.name: Architect-Structure
categories.definition: Entity X is the architect, designer, or firm responsible for designing entity Y, which is a building, structure, or landmark.

categories.name: Award-Nominee
categories.definition: Entity X is an award or nomination received by or associated with entity Y, which is a person, work, or group.

categories.name: Publisher-Work
categories.definition: Entity X is the publisher, record label, or distributor of entity Y, which is a published work such as a book, album, or game.

categories.name: Geographical-Feature
categories.definition: Entity X is a natural feature, such as a river or mountain, located within or part of entity Y, which is a larger geographical feature or region.

categories.name: Adaptation-Source
categories.definition: Entity X is a work adapted from, based on, or a sequel to entity Y, or Y is the original source material for X.

categories.name: Agent-Representation
categories.definition: Entity X is a person or entity represented by or associated with entity Y in a professional capacity, such as a player-coach or artist-label relationship.

categories.name: Product-Platform
categories.definition: Entity X is a product, software, or game designed for or compatible with entity Y, which is a platform, operating system, or hardware.

categories.name: Synonym-Identity
categories.definition: Entity X and entity Y are synonyms, aliases, or different names referring to the same entity or concept.

categories.name: Genre-Style
categories.definition: Entity X is a work, person, or group belonging to or characterized by entity Y, which is a genre, style, or artistic movement.

categories.name: Administrative-Division
categories.definition: Entity X is a political or administrative division, such as a district or constituency, located within entity Y, which is a larger region or country.

categories.name: Instrument-Musician
categories.definition: Entity X is a musical instrument played by entity Y, who is a musician.

categories.name: Succession
categories.definition: Entity X succeeds or holds an office previously held by entity Y, or X is the successor to Y in a specific role.

categories.name: Transportation-Route
categories.definition: Entity X is a transportation facility, such as an airport or station, serving entity Y, which is a city or location.

categories.name: Military-Unit
categories.definition: Entity X is a military unit, vessel, or branch to which entity Y belongs or is affiliated.

categories.name: Religious-Affiliation
categories.definition: Entity X is a person, order, or text associated with entity Y, which is a religion, religious group, or deity.

categories.name: Sports-League
categories.definition: Entity X is a sports team or club that competes in entity Y, which is a sports league or division.

categories.name: Educational-Institution
categories.definition: Entity X is a person who attended or is affiliated with entity Y, which is an educational institution.

categories.name: Government-Agency
categories.definition: Entity X is a government agency, department, or public body operating under or affiliated with entity Y, which is a government or larger entity.
